_about: Rooftop Garden prototype sounds. Every song layer is in G major at 80 bpm, 16 beats, so the garden plays together.

sounds._about: The strawberry's part in the garden's own tune.
The chilli's part in the garden's own tune.
The rose's part in the garden's own tune.
The jasmine's part in the garden's own tune.

sounds._arrangement: 80 beats: A (8 bars); B on harp over C, D and E minor; A2 with a new flute tune over the kalimba before the old one returns.

sounds._about: Sunday bells: on the first Sunday of the month, a church down the street rings for evensong in place of the evening tune.
Waterlogged soil: a slow, low gurgle from an overwatered planter.
Too much water: a splash into soggy soil, then a glug.
Menu move: a soft tap on a clay pot.
Menu select: a water drip and a kalimba note.
Menu back: a soft soil pat.
Pause music: kalimba and flute, the garden at rest.
Seed shed music: a light, plucky tune on guitar and kalimba.
